rationale: This issue tracks what happens when capable AI leaves the lab: guardrails fail, platforms and states expand surveillance, and workers inherit the cleanup. Lab-local biotech, consumer wearables and brain-scan forecasting ground those abstractions in bodies and workplaces.

assignments.angle: White Circle red-teaming finds the newest Google and OpenAI image generators are more capable yet easier to trick into non-consensual nudes.

photo.subject: a young woman sitting on a couch at home holding a smartphone face-down and looking away upset
photo.why: illustrates the harm of non-consensual intimate imagery without showing explicit content

assignments.angle: Meta's Oct. 30 commercial TOS forces business accounts to let its bots crawl linked websites for AI training with no opt-out.
Amazon's Bee launches the $74.99 Frontier wrist-pin and $99.99 Eclipse phone-back notetaker to turn everyday talk into to-dos.
Lincoln Laboratory hosted the federal biotech commission Sept. 3 to link Massachusetts' bioindustrial ecosystem to biodefense.
A federal judge let the EFF-union lawsuit over AI surveillance of visa holders for anti-Trump and pro-Palestine speech move forward.

photo.subject: protesters holding free-speech signs gathered on the steps outside a federal courthouse
photo.why: shows the public free-speech stakes of the immigration social-media surveillance lawsuit

assignments.angle: A Drexel researcher warns reliable AI creates latent risk as overseers lose practice for the rare moment they must intervene.
MIT's survey of 1,810 professionals finds a record 83% call sustainability vital yet 68% retrenched under tariff uncertainty.
A Science Advances model finds over-reliance on priors when seeing angry faces predicts depression up to four years early.
EFF and ACLU ask Wisconsin's Supreme Court to require a warrant for retrospective ALPR tracking in four cities.

rail.point: ImpactBench offers 809 expert-grounded metrics and tested ten frontier LLMs in 48,540 teen and adult conversations.
TouchTwin turns phone scans into editable haptic scenes, lifting realism from 4.0 to 5.6/7 after 6.6 minutes of edits in an N=12 study.
MoltBook agents show about 2x semantic drift and non-significant autocorrelation compared with Reddit and PTT humans.
GPT-4 and GPT-5 depict men as most socially distant and least open to help-seeking versus 76,406-person human data.
Residual Human States framework with four cases shows assisted success does not predict later unaided bias and persistence.
StepSafe trains step-level guards to continue, ask, or stop as evidence accumulates rather than judging whole trajectories.
MemeTrace traces origin, spread and risk for 100 real memes and beats a VLM baseline on unsafe detection.
HD-RL tuned Qwen explanations lifted human AI-text detection from 51.3% to 63.7% accuracy in a randomized trial.
An explainable nurse-scheduling prototype co-designed with experts was evaluated with eye-tracking and questionnaires.
An N=18 cross-platform study finds aerial hazard monitoring lowers situational awareness and raises workload versus ground.
